explain.finding: 2 medicines with strong anticholinergic effects together
ai: AI draft · on this device · Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct · 7.2 s

Margaret takes Tylenol PM and Oxybutynin, both of which block acetylcholine, and together they can cause confusion, constipation, dry mouth, falls, and delirium. That makes it a good topic to raise with the doctor or pharmacist at the next visit to see if all these medicines are still needed together. They might be able to replace some with medicines that have less anticholinergic effect to reduce these risks.
